operations.summary: Decide satisfiability of an SMT-LIB2 script (sat/unsat/unknown)

output.format: sat | unsat | unknown verdict on stdout

operations.summary: Solve and return a satisfying assignment via (get-model)

output.format: sat verdict followed by an SMT-LIB2 (define-fun ...) model block

input.script:
(declare-const x Int)
(declare-const y Int)
(assert (= (+ x y) 10))
(assert (= (- x y) 4))
(check-sat)
(get-model)

operations.summary: Evaluate terms in the model via (get-value (...))

output.format: sat verdict followed by ((term value) ...) pairs

input.script:
(declare-const a Int)
(declare-const b Int)
(assert (= a 6))
(assert (= b 7))
(check-sat)
(get-value ((* a b)))

output.format: sat verdict followed by an (objectives ...) block

operations.summary: Prove a theorem by asserting its negation and checking unsat

output.format: unsat = theorem proved; sat = a counterexample exists

input.script:
(declare-const x Int)
(declare-const y Int)
(assert (> x 0))
(assert (> y 0))
(assert (<= (+ x y) 0))
(check-sat)

operations.summary: Solve over fixed-width bit-vectors (machine arithmetic, bitwise ops)

output.format: sat verdict followed by ((var #xNN)) bit-vector value(s)

operations.summary: Return the minimal conflicting subset of named assertions

output.format: unsat verdict followed by (name ...) of the conflicting assertions

input.script:
(set-option :produce-unsat-cores true)
(declare-const x Int)
(assert (! (> x 10) :named c1))
(assert (! (< x 5) :named c2))
(check-sat)
(get-unsat-core)

operations.summary: Exact real (rational) arithmetic — solve and read fractional values

output.format: sat verdict followed by an exact rational value, e.g. (/ 1.0 3.0)
